accurate.why: Section-by-section claims align with the bill; correctly states 10 Virginia-class submarines under Sec. 123.

no_hallucinations.why: No fabricated content; all provisions traceable to the bill.

states_purpose.why: Opening paragraph states the bill authorizes FY2024 appropriations and policies for DOD, DOE, MARAD, State, and CIA.

changes_to_existing_law.why: Repeatedly describes how sections amend or modify existing programs and requirements.

exceptions_conditions.why: Notes certifications, floors, and conditions (e.g., E-3 fleet-size conditions, T-1A certification).

effective_dates.why: Cites timing and deadlines throughout (e.g., end of FY2028 for RQ-4).

major_provisions_covered.why: Exhaustive title-by-title coverage of all divisions.

coherent.why: Systematically organized by title and section.

concise.why: Long but every line is substantive; no filler or repetition.

correct_entities.why: Programs, systems, and agencies correctly identified.

correct_figures.why: Figures used (e.g., 10 submarines, fleet floors) are correct.
